# 0.15.150

**The call is above the video, always.** A card watched big sat over the call
banner and covered whoever you were talking to. The call and the conversation
share one layer on purpose — the call sits on the conversation and the stream
scrolls under it — so a player that sticks to the top of the stream lands
exactly where the call is, and it was the player that drew on top. It is the
call now, over everything. The player sticks *below* the call rather than
behind it, so it is still watchable while you are in one.

**A video keeps your place.** The frame is never moved in the document, which
is why making it bigger or putting it back has always kept it playing. Now the
position is remembered as well, so anything that does rebuild the frame resumes
where you were instead of starting again. The player reports where it is up to
as it plays; nothing is polled and nothing is fetched, only messages from the
player's own origin are believed, and only a number is taken from them.

This is YouTube only. Vimeo, Instagram and TikTok report their position in
their own ways and are not done, so a rebuilt frame for one of those still
starts at the beginning.
